text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Draft development plan to be published by the end of the year. Maltese Prime Minister Alfred Sant announced preparations of the plan on Sunday but would only say that it would take Malta well beyond the year 2000.
- Two women arrested for suspected drug possession after being stopped at a roadblock.
- Opposition Nationalist Party calls for investigation on selection of agency to handle advertising of new taxation system.
